import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_log_error


# Load data directly from CSV without geometry parsing
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Use only direct CSV features (proven to work best)
feature_cols = [
    "spacegroup",
    "number_of_total_atoms",
    "percent_atom_al",
    "percent_atom_ga",
    "percent_atom_in",
    "lattice_vector_1_ang",
    "lattice_vector_2_ang",
    "lattice_vector_3_ang",
    "lattice_angle_alpha_degree",
    "lattice_angle_beta_degree",
    "lattice_angle_gamma_degree",
]

# Ensure all feature columns exist
train_df = train_df.fillna(0)
test_df = test_df.fillna(0)

# Split for validation (80/20 split)
train_subset, val_subset = train_test_split(train_df, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)

# Prepare training and validation data
X_train = train_subset[feature_cols]
y_train_form = train_subset["formation_energy_ev_natom"]
y_train_gap = train_subset["bandgap_energy_ev"]

X_val = val_subset[feature_cols]
y_val_form = val_subset["formation_energy_ev_natom"]
y_val_gap = val_subset["bandgap_energy_ev"]

# Prepare test data
X_test = test_df[feature_cols]

# Train models for both targets with optimized hyperparameters
params = {
    "objective": "regression",
    "metric": "rmse",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.9,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
}

# Train formation energy model
train_data_form = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train_form)
val_data_form = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val_form, reference=train_data_form)
model_form = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data_form,
    num_boost_round=500,
    valid_sets=[train_data_form, val_data_form],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],
)

# Train bandgap energy model
train_data_gap = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train_gap)
val_data_gap = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val_gap, reference=train_data_gap)
model_gap = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data_gap,
    num_boost_round=500,
    valid_sets=[train_data_gap, val_data_gap],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],
)

# Predict on validation set to compute RMSLE
pred_val_form = model_form.predict(X_val)
pred_val_gap = model_gap.predict(X_val)

# Clip predictions to avoid negative values
pred_val_form = np.maximum(pred_val_form, 0)
pred_val_gap = np.maximum(pred_val_gap, 0)

# Calculate RMSLE for each target
rmsle_form = np.sqrt(mean_squared_log_error(y_val_form, pred_val_form))
rmsle_gap = np.sqrt(mean_squared_log_error(y_val_gap, pred_val_gap))
mean_rmsle = (rmsle_form + rmsle_gap) / 2

print(f"Validation RMSLE - Formation Energy: {rmsle_form:.6f}")
print(f"Validation RMSLE - Bandgap Energy: {rmsle_gap:.6f}")
print(f"Mean Column-wise RMSLE: {mean_rmsle:.6f}")

# Predict on test set and prepare submission
pred_test_form = model_form.predict(X_test)
pred_test_gap = model_gap.predict(X_test)

# Clip predictions to avoid negative values
pred_test_form = np.maximum(pred_test_form, 0)
pred_test_gap = np.maximum(pred_test_gap, 0)

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["id"],
        "formation_energy_ev_natom": pred_test_form,
        "bandgap_energy_ev": pred_test_gap,
    }
)

# Ensure submission directory exists and save
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("\nSubmission file saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
